message.content:
Sure! To pull the graph data for IP 34.56.78.9 from VirusTotal, you’ll need to call the VirusTotal API endpoint that returns the IP’s “network” or “graph” information. The request looks something like this:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/34.56.78.9/network
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
Accept: application/json
```

If you want the “graphs” (e.g., the network graph or the IP’s relationships), you can also hit the `/ip_addresses/{ip}/graphs` endpoint.

Because the API requires authentication, I’ll need the actual API key value (the one you refer to as `sec_key2`). Please paste the key here so I can construct the exact request for you. Once I have it, I can show you the full curl command or the JSON response structure you’ll receive.
